Pain: triage pipeline needs fast ticket creation via function-calling. If streaming mode breaks client-side JSON parsing, they lose real-time triage SLA.
Problem details (customer): 'Sometimes we get an extra "\n" mid-object and our frontend JSON.parse explodes — disabling streaming fixes it but kills UX.'

SE observations: Likely two related causes: 1) schema mismatch enforcement in function-calling stage (we return types not matching declared JSON Schema -> runtime coercion to strings), 2) streaming framing not guaranteeing object chunk boundaries for our SDK's incremental parser.

Immediate workaround suggested: 1) Use non-streaming for critical ticket-create flows, 2) tighten function schema to accept string-coerced fields as fallback, 3) client-side incremental JSON-safe parser (SE provided sample).
Customer constraints: high cost sensitivity, prefers hosted_api (public cloud), no on-prem option. Needs SOC2 and SSO. Wants rollout in 6-8 weeks if PoC succeeds.
